findings.issue_summary: Background agent runs require a Play Console foreground service declaration
findings.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml lines 6–7 and 29–32 declare the foreground-service permissions and the dataSync type. BackgroundRuns.kt lines 109–111 start the foreground service with a notification. The app targets API 35.
findings.recommendation: Verify the dataSync declaration in Play Console under App content. Describe the user-initiated run and the impact of interruption, select the applicable use case, and provide a video showing how to trigger the foreground service. See https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/13392821.
